params.message:
Opening hours: optional text per line, Saturday by appointment

An opening-hours line can carry a note (Sanity openingHoursEntry.note,
localeString, e.g. "op afspraak"). The footer shows it under the day,
the contact page and the seller card on a vehicle page in brackets
after the times, and the contact meta description includes it.

The built-in fallback (and so the seed export) gets Saturday 07:30 to
12:00 by appointment. The live hours stay in Sanity; the Studio field
is in schoutteet-sanity.
